questions.question: In MS Word 365 how can you access the spelling and grammar check feature in Microsoft Word?
questions.questionHtml: In MS Word 365 how can you access the spelling and grammar check feature in Microsoft Word?

options.text: Go to the ‘Home’ tab and click on ‘Spelling & Grammar’
options.html: Go to the ‘Home’ tab and click on ‘Spelling & Grammar’

options.text: Go to the ‘Insert’ tab and click on ‘Spelling & Grammar’
options.html: Go to the ‘Insert’ tab and click on ‘Spelling & Grammar’

options.text: Go to the ‘Review’ tab and click on ‘Spelling & Grammar’
options.html: Go to the ‘Review’ tab and click on ‘Spelling & Grammar’

options.text: Go to the ‘View’ tab and click on ‘Spelling & Grammar’
options.html: Go to the ‘View’ tab and click on ‘Spelling & Grammar’

questions.solution:
The correct answer is Go to the 'Review' tab and click on 'Spelling & Grammar'.

Key Points

  • The 'Review' tab in Microsoft Word contains tools related to reviewing and checking your document for errors.
  • The Spelling & Grammar feature helps you identify and correct spelling and grammatical errors in your document.
  • Using this feature, you can ensure that your document is free from common writing mistakes, which can improve the overall quality and professionalism of your work.
  • The feature also offers suggestions for corrections, making it easier for you to edit your content efficiently.

Additional Information

  • Microsoft Word
    • Microsoft Word is a word processing software developed by Microsoft, and it is part of the Microsoft Office suite.
    • It is used for creating, editing, formatting, and sharing text documents.
    • Word offers a range of features including spell check, grammar check, text formatting, and the ability to insert images, tables, and other elements.
    • It is widely used for creating professional documents such as reports, letters, and resumes.
  • Spelling & Grammar Check Feature
    • This feature scans your document for spelling errors (such as typos) and grammatical issues.
    • It provides suggestions for corrections, allowing you to choose whether to accept or ignore each suggestion.
    • Using this feature regularly can help improve the quality of your writing and ensure clarity and correctness.
    • It is especially useful for professional and academic documents where precision in language is essential.
  • Review Tab in MS Word
    • The Review tab contains tools for proofing, tracking changes, and collaborating with others on a document.
    • In addition to Spelling & Grammar, it includes features like 'Track Changes', 'Comments', 'Compare', and 'Thesaurus'.
    • These tools help users manage document review processes, ensuring that all changes and feedback are tracked and addressed.
    • The Review tab is essential for collaborative work and for finalizing documents before publication or submission.

questions.question: The keyboard shortcut ________ is used to create bullets in MS Word 2010.

Key Points

  • The keyboard shortcut Ctrl + Shift + L is used to create bullets in MS Word 2010.
  • This shortcut allows users to quickly apply a bulleted list format to their selected text.
  • It is a time-saving feature for formatting text in documents, particularly for creating organized lists.
  • Bullets can be customized in MS Word through the "Define New Bullet" option available under the "Bullets" section in the "Home" tab.

Additional Information

    • The "Bullets" option is located under the "Paragraph" group in the "Home" tab in MS Word.

questions.question: Which wireless technology allows devices to connect to the internet within the limited range of a wireless router?
questions.questionHtml: Which wireless technology allows devices to connect to the internet within the limited range of a wireless router?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is Wi-Fi.

Key Points

  • Wi-Fi stands for Wireless Fidelity and is a technology that allows devices to connect to the internet wirelessly within the range of a wireless router.
  • It operates over radio waves, typically in the 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz bands, to transmit data.
  • Wi-Fi is widely used in homes, offices, and public places like cafes and airports to provide internet access.
  • Most modern devices, including smartphones, laptops, and tablets, are equipped with Wi-Fi capabilities to connect to wireless networks.

Additional Information

  • Wireless Router
    • A wireless router is a device that provides access to the internet or a private computer network.
    • It uses radio waves to transmit data and can support multiple devices simultaneously.
    • Most routers come with built-in security features like firewalls and encryption to protect the network.
  • Wi-Fi Standards
    • Wi-Fi standards are developed by the IEEE (Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers).
    • Common standards include 802.11a, 802.11b, 802.11g, 802.11n, and 802.11ac, each offering different speeds and ranges.
  • Hotspot
    • A hotspot is a physical location where people can access the internet via Wi-Fi.
    • Hotspots can be found in public places like cafes, airports, hotels, and libraries.
  • Internet Service Provider (ISP)
    • An ISP is a company that provides internet access to users.
    • ISPs supply the necessary infrastructure, such as cables and routers, to connect users to the internet.

questions.question: ________ is a type of fraud where a small electronic device is used to steal debit/credit card information during an authorised banking transaction.
questions.questionHtml: ________ is a type of fraud where a small electronic device is used to steal debit/credit card information during an authorised banking transaction.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is Skimming.

Key Points

  • Skimming is a type of fraud where a small electronic device is used to steal debit/credit card information during an authorised banking transaction.
  • Skimming is an illegal practice used by identity thieves to capture credit card information from a cardholder surreptitiously.
  • Fraudsters often use a device called a skimmer that can be installed at gas pumps or ATM machines to collect card data.
  • Some machines act like point-of-sale technology. An acquired card is swiped, and a touchpad allows the user to enter a security code.
  • Card users are warned to keep their cards in their sight at all times and to cover the pin pad when inputting security codes at ATMs.

Additional Information

  • Phishing is a fraudulent attempt to obtain sensitive information or data, such as usernames, passwords and credit card details.
  • When the user is tricked into downloading a Trojan horse or other malware onto his mobile through SMS is called Smishing.
  • Voice phishing or vishing is the criminal practice of using social engineering over the telephone system to gain access to private personal and financial information from the public for the purpose of financial reward.

questions.question: Which of the following keyboard shortcuts will you press in order to minimise all programs on a computer screen and display the desktop?
questions.questionHtml: Which of the following keyboard shortcuts will you press in order to minimise all programs on a computer screen and display the desktop?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is Windows + D.

Key Points

  • Windows + D- Minimise all programs on a computer screen and display the desktop
  • Windows + M- Minimize all windows
  • Windows + C- Nothing in particular
  • Windows + F- Start a Feedback dialog

Confusion Points

  • Windows key + M minimizes all open windows – “M” for “Minimize.”
    • Win + M minimizes all opened windows excluding those which do not support WM_MINIMIZE;
  • Windows key + D also minimizes all open windows – “D” for “Desktop.”
    • Win + D shows the desktop in any case. ​

​As Question is about minimising all programs on a computer screen and displaying the desktop. Hence Windows key + D is the correct answer.

Additional Information

  • Windows logo key + Pause- Display the System Properties dialog box
  • Windows logo key + Shift + M- Restore minimized windows to the desktop
  • Windows logo key + E- Open Computer
  • Windows logo key + F- Start a Feedback dialog
  • Ctrl+ Windows logo key + F- Search for computers (if you're on a network)
  • Windows logo key + L- Lock your computer or switch users
  • Windows logo key + R- Open the Run dialog box
  • Windows logo key + T- Cycle through programs on the Taskbar

questions.question: In MS - Word 365, which option allows you to apply a specific style to a selected portion of text, such as changing the font, font size, color and other formatting attributes, while keeping the rest of the text unaffected ?
questions.questionHtml: In MS - Word 365, which option allows you to apply a specific style to a selected portion of text, such as changing the font, font size, color and other formatting attributes, while keeping the rest of the text unaffected ?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is Format Painter.

  • You can use Format Painter by selecting the text with the desired formatting, clicking the Format Painter icon, and then selecting the text you want to format.
  • Format Painter can be used multiple times by double-clicking the icon, allowing for consistent formatting across multiple sections of a document.

Additional Information

  • Character Style:
    • Character styles are a collection of character formatting attributes that can be applied to text in MS Word.
    • They include font type, size, color, and other text properties.
    • However, character styles are applied to entire sections or selected text, not just a portion within a selected text.
  • Quick Style:
    • Quick Styles are predefined styles in MS Word that you can use to quickly format text.
    • They include a combination of font, color, and size settings designed to create a cohesive look for your document.
    • Quick Styles are typically used for larger sections such as headings, paragraphs, and lists.
  • Clear Formatting:
    • The Clear Formatting option removes all formatting from the selected text, reverting it to the default style of the document.
    • It is useful when you need to start fresh with the formatting of a particular section of text.

questions.question: Which of the following signs appears when you drag the fill handle while creating text, number and data series in MS Excel 365?
questions.questionHtml: Which of the following signs appears when you drag the fill handle while creating text, number and data series in MS Excel 365?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is +.

Key Points

  • In MS Excel 365, the fill handle is a small square at the bottom-right corner of the selected cell or range of cells.
  • Dragging the fill handle is used to copy cell contents or to complete a series (e.g., numbers, dates, or text).
  • When dragging the fill handle, the + sign appears, indicating that the fill operation is active.
  • The fill handle can be used to automatically continue a series, such as days of the week, months, or numerical sequences.
  • It significantly enhances productivity by automating repetitive tasks in spreadsheets.

Additional Information

  • AutoFill Feature
    • AutoFill in Excel allows users to fill cells with repetitive or sequential data automatically.
    • It can be used for text, numbers, dates, and formulas.
    • Users can customize series by specifying the type of fill operation in the AutoFill options.
  • Series Completion
    • Excel can recognize patterns and automatically complete series based on the initial selection.
    • Commonly used series include numeric sequences, dates, and weekdays.
  • Custom Lists
    • Users can create custom lists in Excel to use with the fill handle for personalized series.
    • These lists can include any repetitive data, like department names or project codes.
  • Fill Handle Shortcuts
    • Double-clicking the fill handle copies the content down the column until it reaches an empty cell.
    • Holding the Ctrl key while dragging the fill handle forces a copy instead of a series completion.

questions.question: How do we move a piece of text from one place to another in Microsoft Word 365?
questions.questionHtml: How do we move a piece of text from one place to another in Microsoft Word 365?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is Cut and Paste.

Key Points

  • Cut and Paste is a feature used in word processing software like Microsoft Word 365 to move text from one location to another.

  • Using the Paste command, the text from the clipboard is inserted into the new location where the cursor is placed.

Additional Information

  • Clipboard

    • When you cut or copy text, it is stored in the clipboard until it is replaced by new data or the system is shut down.

  • Cut Command
    • In Microsoft Word 365, the Cut command can be accessed by right-clicking the selected text and choosing "Cut" from the context menu or by using the shortcut Ctrl + X.
    • This command removes the text from its current position and places it on the clipboard.
  • Paste Command
    • The Paste command is used to insert the text from the clipboard into the new location.
    • In Microsoft Word 365, you can paste the text by right-clicking where you want to insert the text and selecting "Paste" or by using the shortcut Ctrl + V.
  • Copy and Paste
    • While similar to Cut and Paste, the Copy command duplicates the selected text and places the copy on the clipboard without removing it from its original location.
    • The Paste command is then used to insert the copied text into the desired location.
    • The shortcut for Copy is Ctrl + C in Microsoft Word 365.

questions.question: In MS Excel 365, the VLOOKUP function in Microsoft Excel is primarily used for:
questions.questionHtml: In MS Excel 365, the VLOOKUP function in Microsoft Excel is primarily used for:

options.text: searching for a value in a table and returning a corresponding value
options.html: searching for a value in a table and returning a corresponding value

options.text: finding the total of a range
options.html: finding the total of a range

questions.solution:
The correct answer is searching for a value in a table and returning a corresponding value.

Key Points

  • The VLOOKUP function stands for Vertical Lookup and is used to search for a value in the first column of a table or range and return a value in the same row from a specified column.
  • This function is useful when you need to find specific information in large spreadsheets, such as retrieving employee names based on their ID numbers.
  • VLOOKUP requires four arguments: the value to search for, the range to search within, the column number of the value to return, and a logical value to indicate exact or approximate match.
  • VLOOKUP is especially useful in database-like scenarios where data is organized in columns and you need to retrieve related information.

Additional Information

  • Range: A range in Excel is a collection of two or more cells. This can be a single row, a single column, or multiple rows and columns.
  • Column Index Number: The column index number is the number of the column in the range from which to retrieve the value. For example, if you want to retrieve the value from the third column of the range, you would use 3 as the column index number.
  • Exact vs. Approximate Match: The fourth argument in VLOOKUP is a logical value indicating whether to find an exact match or an approximate match. If TRUE or omitted, an approximate match is returned. If FALSE, VLOOKUP will find an exact match.
  • Error Handling: If VLOOKUP cannot find the value you are looking for, it returns the #N/A error. This can be handled using the IFERROR function to provide a default value or message.

questions.solution:

Key Points

  • It operates by transmitting data over the coaxial cables that are used for cable television services.

Additional Information

  • DSL (Digital Subscriber Line)

  • Dial-up

    • It is significantly slower than both DSL and cable Internet.
  • Fiber-optic Internet
    • Fiber-optic Internet uses fiber-optic cables to transmit data at very high speeds, often faster than both DSL and cable Internet.
    • It provides a more stable and reliable connection with higher bandwidth.
  • Coaxial Cables
    • Coaxial cables are a type of electrical cable consisting of a central conductor, an insulating layer, a metallic shield, and an outer insulating layer.
    • They are commonly used for cable television and Internet services due to their ability to carry high-frequency signals with low interference.

questions.question: What is the role of routers in Internet architecture ?
questions.questionHtml: What is the role of routers in Internet architecture ?

options.text: To provide security for Internet connections
options.html: To provide security for Internet connections

options.text: To receive and send data on computer networks.
options.html: To receive and send data on computer networks.

options.text: To translate IP addresses into domain names
options.html: To translate IP addresses into domain names

options.text: To connect devices to the Internet
options.html: To connect devices to the Internet

questions.solution:
The correct answer is To receive and send data on computer networks.

Key Points

  • Routers are networking devices that forward data packets between computer networks.
  • They perform traffic directing functions on the Internet and ensure that data sent from one network gets to the right destination.
  • Routers operate at the network layer (Layer 3) of the OSI model, making decisions based on IP addresses.
  • They connect different networks together, enabling communication between devices on different networks and managing traffic efficiently.

Additional Information

  • IP Address:
    • An Internet Protocol (IP) address is a unique identifier assigned to each device connected to a computer network that uses the IP for communication.
    • IP addresses are used by routers to determine the destination of data packets.
  • Domain Name System (DNS):
    • The DNS translates domain names (like www.example.com) into IP addresses that routers and switches can use to route packets.
    • While crucial for user-friendly web navigation, translating IP addresses into domain names is not the primary function of routers.
  • Network Layer (Layer 3) of the OSI Model:
    • The network layer is responsible for the delivery of packets from the source host to the destination host based on their IP addresses.
    • Routers are critical components at this layer, managing the path that data takes to reach its destination.
  • Switches vs. Routers:
    • While both switches and routers are used in network environments, they serve different purposes.
    • Switches operate at the data link layer (Layer 2) and are used to connect devices within the same network, while routers operate at the network layer and are used to connect different networks.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is Broadband provides faster internet speeds compared to dialup..

Key Points

  • Broadband connections offer significantly higher data transfer speeds compared to dialup connections, providing a more efficient and faster internet experience.
  • Broadband internet is always on, meaning there is no need to dial in each time you want to connect to the internet, unlike dialup.
  • Broadband allows for simultaneous use of internet and telephone services, whereas dialup uses the telephone line, making it unavailable for calls during internet usage.
  • Broadband connections can support modern internet applications such as streaming, gaming, and large file downloads, which are difficult to manage on slower dialup connections.

Additional Information

  • Dialup Connection:
    • Dialup connection uses a modem and a standard telephone line to connect to an ISP.
    • Typical dialup speeds are up to 56 kbps, which is significantly slower than broadband.
    • Dialup connections often experience busy signals and require manual connection setup each time.
  • Broadband Types:
    • DSL (Digital Subscriber Line): Utilizes existing telephone lines but offers higher speeds without tying up the phone line.
    • Cable Internet: Uses the cable television infrastructure to provide high-speed internet access.
    • Fiber Optic: Provides the fastest internet speeds by using light to transmit data through fiber optic cables.
    • Satellite Internet: Uses satellite communication for internet access, useful in remote areas.
  • Latency:
    • Latency refers to the delay in data transmission. Broadband connections generally have lower latency compared to dialup.
    • Lower latency is crucial for real-time applications such as video conferencing and online gaming.
  • Data Cap and Unlimited Plans:
    • Broadband plans may come with data caps or unlimited data usage options, offering flexibility based on user needs.
    • Dialup connections typically offer unlimited usage but are limited by slow speeds.
